# Wasteland Jamboree in Sutton / Flatwoods (West Viriginia) on May 2nd/3rd, 2026

![Wasteland Jamboree in Sutton / Flatwoods (West Viriginia) on May 2nd/3rd, 2026](/uploads/670_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

### The world's largest post-apocalyptic fanfest is coming to West Virginia:

## Wasteland Jamboree Announces First Appalachian Event to Benefit Mountaineer Food Bank

**SUTTON, WV** – March 16, 2026 – The wasteland is calling. This spring, fans of post-apocalyptic gaming culture from across the country will gather in the heart of Appalachia for the Wasteland Jamboree, a two-day, family-friendly benefit that combines gaming culture, live music, immersive experiences and community fundraising.

The Wasteland Jamboree will take place on **2. and May 3, 2026** at the Flatwoods Conference Center and the Sutton/Flatwoods KOA in Sutton, West Virginia, bringing together fans, creators, musicians, cosplayers and storytellers - according to organizers, the **largest post-apocalyptic fanfest in the world**.

Produced by **Buttered Popcorn Productions** in collaboration with **Fallout For Hope** and the historic **Pioneer Saloon**, the event captures the spirit of the Appalachian wasteland and features a mix of carnival and post-apocalypse atmosphere with music, games, immersive experiences and charitable efforts to benefit the **Mountaineer Food Bank**, a Feeding America partner that provides food to communities in need throughout West Virginia.

“The Wasteland Jamboree is about bringing the community together and celebrating creativity, fan culture and the Appalachian spirit,” said Stephen Staats, founder of Buttered Popcorn Productions. “We wanted to create something that feels authentic to the region and gives fans the opportunity to immerse themselves in the world they love – in a way that makes a real difference for the people here.”

### Two-day celebration of post-apocalyptic culture

The Wasteland Jamboree is a **collaborative experience created by the community itself**.

It is organized by Buttered Popcorn Productions together with numerous volunteers and creatives from the gaming and fan community.

At the weekend visitors can expect:

- **Two days of live folk, bluegrass and country music** in a 1,700-seat amphitheater
- **A merchant village** with artists, creatives and themed merchandise
- **Food trucks from the region**
- **An immersive LARP zone** where guests can explore a living piece of wasteland
- **A nuclear fairground and carnival** in nearby Holly-Gray Park
- **Panels, Community Meetups, and Fan-Crafted Experiences**

“The Wasteland Jamboree was created from the ground up by fans and creators who love this universe and want to share their passion with others,” said Brian “Chip” McLaughlin, executive director of the event. “Our goal is to provide a welcoming, engaging and memorable experience while mobilizing the community around an important cause.”

### Charity in the Heart of the Wasteland

The focus of the Wasteland Jamboree is supporting hungry families throughout West Virginia.

Organizers are working with **Braxton County** and the **Mountaineer Food Bank**, a partner of Feeding America, to raise funds and awareness of the issue. It is estimated that more than **266,000 West Virginians** will be food insecure in 2026 – including over **73,000 children**. In **Braxton County alone, 17.2% of residents** struggle to obtain regular food supplies.
